title: Leaving Tommy Miles's band for Long Branch, 1941
summary: Phillips left the Miles band in late May or June 1941 to go to Long Branch, New Jersey.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Let's try to pick up with '41. You played with Tommy Miles through '41. What month was it in '41 when you left Tommy Miles' band?
Must have been about... I left then and I went to Long Branch, New Jersey. It must have been round about June -- the latter part of May or the first of June.
